plugins.microphonePermission: Jarvis listens while you hold the mic button.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Jarvis turns your voice into text to answer you.

plugins.photosPermission: Jarvis looks at photos you choose to share with it.
plugins.cameraPermission: Jarvis uses the camera when you take a photo to ask about.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Jarvis uses your approximate location for questions like "what's open near me", only when you turn it on in Settings.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: With place reminders on, Jarvis watches the places you saved so it can remind you when you arrive or leave, even while it's closed.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Jarvis uses Face ID to unlock, if you turn on the lock in Settings.
